tasks.title: Enforce the lib/services boundary: server-only, lint rules, boundary test, build in CI
tasks.dod: server-only is a dependency, ESLint rejects next/headers|next/cache|next/navigation|@/auth|next-auth imports and 'as ActingFreelancer' casts under lib/services, tests/unit/service-layer-boundary.test.ts passes (fails on a planted 'use server' or client import), and CI runs pnpm build.

tasks.title: Move the result contract and result helpers into the shared business-layer kernel
tasks.dod: types/result.ts holds the ActionResult union and types/actions.ts re-exports it; failed()/zodValidationFailure()/hasInvoicesConflict() live in lib/services/_shared/result-helpers.ts with the old path re-exporting; owner-scope maps P2025 to NOT_FOUND (unit test); the existing failed-reports-once tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Add the branded ActingFreelancer, its three factories and the Intl-and-PostgreSQL time-zone resolution
tasks.dod: actingFreelancerFromSession() returns UNAUTHORIZED without a live account and an ActingFreelancer otherwise; actingFreelancerForTest() works without a request; resolveTimeZone() keeps a zone only if Intl and pg_timezone_names both know it, else UTC (integration test with a zone missing from one side); the pure day-bound helpers live in lib/services/_shared/time-zone.ts and lib/helpers/time-zone.ts re-exports them.

tasks.title: Add the shared ListQuery schema, the Page envelope and the paginate helper
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover the full-list-as-page-1 case, a page without a size (10), page 99 falling back to page 1, the empty list (page 1, 0 pages), and VALIDATION for page/pageSize 0, -5, 2.5 and a 101-character search, with the contract's fieldErrors messages.

tasks.title: Wrap the current dashboard actions in dashboard.<section> Sentry spans to start the latency baseline
tasks.dod: Each of the seven dashboard actions runs inside a Sentry span named dashboard.<section> (unit test with a mocked startSpan), and the dashboard's outputs and existing tests are unchanged.

tasks.title: Move customers into lib/services/customers with search, paging and owner-scoped writes
tasks.dod: listCustomers/getCustomer/createCustomer/updateCustomer/deleteCustomer pass request-free integration tests, including search 'ACME' page 1 size 2 (AC-11), HAS_INVOICES with the race recount (AC-17) and a foreign-record test per id-taking function; customer-actions.ts is a thin wrapper and the existing customer tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Move products into lib/services/products with search, paging and owner-scoped writes
tasks.dod: listProducts (incl. onlyActive)/getProduct/createProduct/updateProduct/deleteProduct/toggleProductActive pass request-free integration tests, including the used-in-invoices CONFLICT and a foreign-record test per id-taking function; product-actions.ts is a thin wrapper and the existing product tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Move custom prices into lib/services/custom-prices with parent-scoped lists and owner-scoped writes
tasks.dod: listCustomerCustomPrices/listProductCustomPrices return NOT_FOUND for a foreign or missing parent and a Page otherwise; create/update/delete are owner-scoped through customer and product; foreign-record tests pass; custom-price-actions.ts is a thin wrapper and the existing tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Move sender profiles into lib/services/sender-profiles and route the convert-image logo lookup through it
tasks.dod: listSenderProfiles/getSenderProfile/getSenderProfileLogo/create/update/deleteSenderProfile pass request-free integration tests, including HAS_INVOICES with the race recount and foreign-record tests; convert-image reads the logo through the layer with its HTTP responses unchanged; existing tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Move bank accounts into lib/services/bank-accounts with a parent-scoped list
tasks.dod: listBankAccounts (NOT_FOUND on a foreign profile, never searching accountNumber or iban)/create/update/deleteBankAccount pass request-free and foreign-record integration tests; getBankAccounts(id, limit) maps limit to page 1; the wrapper keeps today's revalidatePath list; existing tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Move profile, account deletion, data export and the dashboard setup check into the layer
tasks.dod: updateProfile/getAccountDeletionSummary/deleteAccount/getAccountExport/checkSetup pass request-free integration tests; a failure partway through deleteAccount removes nothing (AC-20); a vanished User row returns NOT_FOUND and the wrappers map it to today's UNAUTHORIZED / export 500; the export route's HTTP response is unchanged.

tasks.title: Move invoice numbering, getInvoice, the editor data and the next-number preview into lib/services/invoices
tasks.dod: numbering.ts lives in lib/services/invoices with the old path re-exporting; getInvoice/getInvoiceEditorData/peekNextInvoiceNumber pass request-free and foreign-record integration tests; the editor data carries the Customer's custom price (AC-25); the wrappers and existing tests are unchanged.

tasks.title: Add listInvoices with validated filters and local-date bounds, and delete the unused list-all function
tasks.dod: listInvoices returns an InvoicePage identical to the invoices page for the same filters, refuses unknown status/tab/sort and reversed or one-ended date ranges with VALIDATION, counts the Kyiv 00:30 1 October invoice in October; getPaginatedInvoices maps items to invoices; getInvoicesByCustomer/BySenderProfile go through it; getInvoices() and its test are deleted.

tasks.title: Move createInvoice into the layer with owned references and numbering under the row lock
tasks.dod: createInvoice (request-free) takes the next sequence number when none is given, blocks a typed duplicate with the sender-profile message, answers NOT_FOUND and stores nothing for a foreign customer/sender profile/bank account/product, and two concurrent saves never share a number; the existing create-invoice tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Move updateInvoice and updateInvoiceStatus into the layer with the totals check and the paid-date rule
tasks.dod: updateInvoice returns CONFLICT TOTALS_CHANGED for an unconfirmed legacy total and NOT_FOUND for a foreign invoice or reference; updateInvoiceStatus refuses an unknown status, reads-then-writes under the owner in one transaction and applies the paid-date rule; request-free and foreign-record tests pass; existing update tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Move duplicateInvoice and deleteInvoice into the layer
tasks.dod: duplicateInvoice creates a draft dated today in the actor's zone, due in 30 days, with the next sequence number and the original unchanged; deleteInvoice refuses a non-draft with CONFLICT; both answer NOT_FOUND for a foreign invoice with B's row unchanged; existing tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Build the dashboard SQL for currency tabs, summary stats and the chart, with the old-vs-new parity harness
tasks.dod: getCurrencyTabs/getSummaryStats/getChartData run owner-joined parameterized $queryRaw inside dashboard.<section> spans; DashboardPeriod local dates are resolved in actor.timeZone; the AC-05 fixture parity test compares them with the old actions to the cent and asserts rows per query; a two-Freelancer test shows B's invoices never count.

tasks.title: Build the dashboard SQL for sender accounts, recent invoices, Debtors and Expected payments
tasks.dod: getSenderAccounts/getRecentInvoices/getDebtors/getExpectedPayments pass the AC-05 parity test, the AC-06 naming and tie-order test and the row-count assertions; each query is owner-joined and has a two-Freelancer test.

tasks.title: Switch the dashboard wrappers to the layer, pass local-date periods, record parity values and delete the in-memory code
tasks.dod: dashboardParamsSchema returns local {from,to} dates; the seven dashboard actions are thin wrappers (currency tabs still in unstable_cache 60 s); the parity test runs on recorded expected values; the old in-memory bodies are deleted; dashboard page tests pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Close the move: zero data-store calls in lib/actions, inventory checks for request-free and foreign-record tests
tasks.dod: A unit check finds 0 prisma imports under lib/actions (except login-actions) and app route handlers; an inventory test fails if any exported business function lacks a request-free test or (when it takes an id) a foreign-record test; functions left unused by the move are deleted; the full suite is green.

tasks.title: Harden list input and ordering: own-key status check, page bounds, literal search wildcards, id tiebreak on editor data and filter options
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-01 S-01, S-07, S-09, S-10 fixed. listInvoices refuses status 'constructor', 'toString' and '__proto__' with VALIDATION "Unknown status." (a z.nativeEnum union, as in search-params.ts), and the refusal table covers them. listQuerySchema caps page and pageSize at 2^31-1 with the existing messages, so 1e20 is VALIDATION, not FAILED. An integration test searches '%' and '_' on customers and custom prices and expects only literal matches; if it fails, ilikeAny and the custom-price search escape backslash, % and _. Every editor-data and filter-option list ends its orderBy with { id: 'asc' }, custom prices get an explicit order, and a test with two equal-named records pins a stable order.

tasks.title: Put the owner in the where clause of numbering, the invoice-items delete, the bank-account default reset and the custom-price lists (ADR-0003)
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-01 S-05 fixed. lockSenderProfileRow, allocateInvoiceNumber and peekNextInvoiceNumber take the actor (or userId) and match AND "userId" = ${userId}; zero rows becomes NOT_FOUND, not a TypeError. The invoiceItem.deleteMany in updateInvoice filters by invoice.senderProfile.userId. Both bank-account updateMany calls add senderProfile: { userId }. The custom-price list where clauses add customer/product: { userId }. Foreign-record tests call each numbering helper with B's profile as A and assert NOT_FOUND and B's invoiceCounter unchanged.

tasks.title: Restore wrapper parity: currency-tab creation order, preview lists without a limit, one Sentry event per logo failure, the shared session factory and the route time-zone fallback
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-01 S-02, S-03, S-04, S-06, S-11 fixed. queryCurrencyTabs orders by MIN(createdAt), MIN(id) per currency; harness.ts no longer sorts tabs, and a test with USD created before EUR expects [USD, EUR]. getInvoicesByCustomer/getInvoicesBySenderProfile pass page/pageSize only when limit is given (as getBankAccounts does) and keep their old failure messages. convert-image returns a 500 without throwing a new Error (or throws 'load_failed'), with a unit test asserting exactly one captureException. bank-account-actions and custom-price-actions use actingFreelancerFromSession from @/lib/helpers/session-actor; a no-restricted-imports rule limits createActingFreelancer to session-actor.ts and tests/support, and the inventory test checks the import source. actingFreelancerForRoute falls back to UTC (or returns FAILED) when the time-zone lookup throws, and /api/user/export then returns its EXPORT_FAILED body.

tasks.title: Pin the untested promises: foreign sender profile on update, every invoice sort, the sender-name and in-period naming rule, record identity in the parity snapshot
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-01 S-08 fixed. update-invoice.test.ts has a sender-profile case (A's invoice onto B's profile → NOT_FOUND, nothing stored, B's counter unchanged). list-invoices.test.ts runs it.each over the five sort fields × asc/desc on fixtures with distinct values. naming-order.test.ts covers a renamed sender (newer invoice created first) and a newest invoice outside the period. The parity snapshot carries stable record identifiers (invoice numbers or fixture labels) for sender accounts, Debtors, recent invoices and expected payments. No existing expected value changes.

tasks.title: Cut the services-to-actions import edge: import helpers and numbering from lib/services, move select-queries into the layer, delete the shims
tasks.dod: Review 2026-10-01 S-12 fixed. Nothing under lib/services imports from @/lib/actions; select-queries.ts lives in lib/services/invoices; the lib/actions/invoice-actions/{helpers,numbering}.ts and action-result-helpers.ts re-export shims are deleted where nothing else uses them. A boundary lint rule or the inventory test fails on any lib/services → lib/actions import. Full suite, lint, tsc and pnpm build are green.

tasks.title: Restore the user-facing messages: the generic logo warning on a failed lookup and the old preview-list failure messages
tasks.dod: Re-review 2026-10-01 R-01 and R-03 fixed. On a failed sender-profile logo lookup, /api/convert-image still returns 500 with one Sentry event, but the client shows 'The logo could not be loaded from this link.' A test runs the route response through fetchLogoDataUrl and checks that warning. When getInvoicesByCustomer and getInvoicesBySenderProfile fail with FAILED, they return 'Failed to fetch customer invoices.' and 'Failed to fetch sender profile invoices.' as before, and a unit test asserts both. The public-api.md:215 row says page and pageSize are passed only when a limit is given. Unit tests, lint and tsc are green.

tasks.title: Re-record the record identities in the dashboard parity snapshot from the old dashboard actions
tasks.dod: Re-review 2026-10-01 R-04 fixed. The *.records keys in recorded-values.ts are produced once by running snapshotDashboard and fixtureLabels against the old lib/actions/dashboard-actions.ts, in a throwaway worktree at the commit before T19. The file header names that commit as the source. The parity test passes against the layer. If the old and new code pick different records, stop and report it instead of re-pinning.

tasks.title: Close the remaining list and owner gaps: order the editor bank accounts, a clear page-cap message, tests for the item-delete owner and the foreign-profile NOT_FOUND
tasks.dod: Re-review 2026-10-01 R-02, R-05, R-06 and R-07 fixed. In editor-data, the nested bankAccounts select ends its orderBy with { id: 'asc' }, and the AC-25 test in list-hardening.test.ts asserts the bank-account order. When page or pageSize is above the cap, the error says the allowed range (1 to 2147483647). The list-query.ts comment and public-api.md section 1.3 both describe the cap. owner-in-where.test.ts asserts the owner clause in the where of invoiceItem.deleteMany. Unit tests mock the numbering to throw SenderProfileNotFoundError and assert { success: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', error: 'Sender profile not found.' } for create, update and duplicate. The full suite, lint and tsc are green.

tasks.title: Align the session factories on a failed time-zone lookup and make the boundary checks catch relative imports
tasks.dod: Re-review 2026-10-01 R-08 and R-09 fixed. When the time-zone lookup fails, actingFreelancerForRoute and actingFreelancerFromSession behave the same way, and public-api.md section 1 documents that behaviour. The comment in session-actor-route-tz.test.ts is correct, and the test asserts captureException is called once. Both the regex in service-layer-boundary.test.ts and the ESLint no-restricted-imports patterns reject relative imports from lib/services into lib/actions. The ignores entry in eslint.config.mjs that does nothing is removed. Unit tests and lint are green.

tasks.title: Pin the convert-image time-zone-failure response and bring the sync report's page cap in line with the contract
tasks.dod: Re-review 2026-10-02 N-1 and N-3 fixed. A unit test makes the time-zone lookup fail for POST /api/convert-image and asserts status 502, the UNAVAILABLE body from contracts/public-api.md and the warning that fetchLogoDataUrl shows ('The logo could not be loaded from this link.'). The test fails if the failureResponse argument at app/api/convert-image/route.ts:39 is dropped. contracts/api-sync-report.md lines 23 and 54 state the 1 to 2147483647 page and page-size range, matching public-api.md section 1.3. Unit tests are green.

tasks.title: Close the remaining import forms the services-to-actions boundary checks miss
tasks.dod: Re-review 2026-10-02 N-2 fixed. The regex in tests/unit/service-layer-boundary.test.ts rejects side-effect imports, static and dynamic imports (including template-literal specifiers), require calls and baseUrl imports ('lib/actions/...') from lib/services into lib/actions, and the test has cases for each form. The ESLint no-restricted-imports patterns in eslint.config.mjs target lib/actions only and no longer reject an unrelated local ./actions module under lib/services. Unit tests and lint are green.

tasks.title: Anchor the services-to-actions ESLint zone rule to the repo root
tasks.dod: Re-review 2026-10-02-2 S-1 fixed. The import/no-restricted-paths rule in eslint.config.mjs sets basePath to the config file's directory (import.meta.dirname), so the zone lib/services -> lib/actions resolves the same way whatever directory ESLint runs from. Verified: running eslint from inside lib/services on a file that imports '../../actions/...' reports the violation, the same as running it from the repo root. Unit tests and lint are green.
